blocked.notes: Wrapper object with `total`, `limit`, `offset`, and `has_more`; iterate with `.issues[]`.

capabilities.notes: Machine-readable command, feature, safety, exit-code, and env-var inventory.

comments list.notes: Empty array if no comments. ErrorEnvelope on stdout if the issue id cannot be resolved.

coordination status.notes: Read-only object with workspace summary and `claims[]` rows. The full envelope schema is `CoordinationStatusOutput`.

count.notes: Ungrouped `br count --json`; scalar count under `.count`. Grouped variants use the `count --by` entry.

count --by.notes: For `br count --by <status|priority|type|assignee|label> --json`. The wrapper object also includes `total`.

dep tree.notes: Pre-order traversal; each node carries a `depth` field.

info.notes: Workspace info object (paths, mode, config snapshot).

init.notes: Successful initialization receipt with resolved paths, stored prefix, and file outcomes. --force reuses existing issues and rewrites metadata; it does not reset the database. Structured errors are emitted on stdout.

list.notes: Wrapper object with pagination metadata; iterate with `.issues[]`. The wrapper exists so totals/cursors can ride alongside the rows.

robot-docs guide.notes: JSON/TOON modes wrap the concise agent guide; text mode prints the guide directly.

search.notes: Stable wrapper object `{"issues": [...], "hidden_closed_count": N}`; iterate with `.issues[]`. The count is zero when no closed matches were hidden or the selected corpus already includes closed issues. Pagination metadata also reports `limit`, `offset`, and `has_more`; `has_more` discloses truncation.

show.notes: Array containing each requested issue; a single requested ID yields one element. On a missing ID, an ErrorEnvelope is written to stdout and exit code is non-zero.

sync --migrate-source-repo-path.notes: Read-only plan by default. Apply requires the exact plan_sha256 from an identically configured reviewed dry-run via --expect-plan-sha256. Uses the crash-recoverable sync publication saga and never probes Git.

sync --reconcile-additive.notes: Dry-run by default. Apply requires the exact plan_sha256 from an identically configured reviewed dry-run via --expect-plan-sha256. Structured machine-mode errors are currently emitted on stdout.

vcs-status.notes: Explicit bounded read-only Git diagnostic. It is isolated from sync, retains HEAD/index evidence when worktree comparison is unavailable, never executes Git content filters, and reports sequential evidence with observation_atomic=false. Structured machine-mode errors are currently emitted on stdout.
